description: Every concrete factual/citation correction from ai-artifacts/agent-reliability-benchmark/review/accuracy.md: severity, exact quote, evidence, smallest fix, disposition, and final accuracy verdict.

accuracyCorrections.report_quote: "The durable ledger has no general-result text, artifact record, delivery state, provider message ID, or retry schedule (`src/durable-objects/task-ledger.ts:95-166`; `src/tasks/types.ts:1-82`)."
accuracyCorrections.why_correct: The ledger does contain a `deliveries` table used for ingress deduplication; the statement as written can be misread as claiming literally no deliveries table. The intent (no per-task egress delivery state) is correct but ambiguous.
accuracyCorrections.evidence: src/durable-objects/task-ledger.ts: contains CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deliveries ... and uses deliveries in claimTelegram()/claimGitHub() for dedupe
accuracyCorrections.smallest_fix: Reword to explicitly note `deliveries` exists and that per-task egress delivery state is missing. Suggested one-line replacement present in this artifact.
accuracyCorrections.disposition: Apply: rewrite wording as suggested (not a code change).

accuracyCorrections.report_quote: Primary sources: mixed unpinned doc/website links and pinned GitHub snapshots (b814b82, a68736f, 319fd69).
accuracyCorrections.why_correct: Unpinned links reduce reproducibility; commits/branches can change semantics. The evidence audit already flags this as a citation-quality issue.
accuracyCorrections.evidence: research/20-evidence-audit.md and repo metadata (node_modules packages contain installed versions; external links are unpinned)
accuracyCorrections.smallest_fix: Pin external links to commit/tag permalinks or annotate with a '(checked YYYY-MM-DD; not pinned)' parenthetical.
accuracyCorrections.disposition: Apply: prefer pinned permalinks; where not possible add check date. (Operational requirement for auditability).

accuracyCorrections.report_quote: "agent narration alone is not operational success. An `agent_end` attempts to fail and clean up only if the task is still active; a task already completed by a terminal tool is not overwritten (`src/observability/task-activity.ts:92-114,144-163`; `src/durable-objects/task-ledger.ts:1303-1321`)."
accuracyCorrections.why_correct: Accurate, but needs the explicit ACTIVE_TASK_STATUSES whitelist so readers don't open code to confirm behavior.
accuracyCorrections.smallest_fix: Add parenthetical naming the statuses: '(markTaskStatus only updates from ACTIVE_TASK_STATUSES — accepted, queued, running)'.

accuracyCorrections.report_quote: "pre-dispatch exceptions cause queue retry; six application attempts are allowed, with exponential delay, before `failTaskMessage` (`src/cloudflare.ts:84-149`). Wrangler also configures the Queue consumer with `max_retries: 5` (`wrangler.jsonc:35-43`)."
accuracyCorrections.why_correct: Statements are correct but risk off-by-one confusion — config `max_retries:5` plus initial attempt equals up to 6 attempts, which matches MAX_QUEUE_ATTEMPTS = 6 in code.
accuracyCorrections.evidence: src/cloudflare.ts sets MAX_QUEUE_ATTEMPTS = 6; wrangler.jsonc sets max_retries: 5 in queue consumer.
accuracyCorrections.smallest_fix: Add clarifying parenthetical: '(Wrangler\'s `max_retries: 5` config leads to up to 6 total attempts including the initial delivery; this matches `MAX_QUEUE_ATTEMPTS = 6` in `src/cloudflare.ts`.)'

accuracyCorrections.report_quote: Test coverage gaps called out in report (missing E2E tests for delivery-failure and result-persistence scenarios).
accuracyCorrections.why_correct: Coverage gap exists; report already recommends tests to add.
accuracyCorrections.evidence: report sections and local-verification.md references to missing test exercises; tests to add suggested in review/accuracy.md
accuracyCorrections.smallest_fix: Add tests: src/tools/task-tools.test.ts to inject Telegram failures; src/tasks/processor.test.ts to exercise pre-dispatch uncertainty.
accuracyCorrections.disposition: Follow-up: operational engineering task; recommended but not applied in review pass.

(See src/durable-objects/task-ledger.ts and src/tasks/types.ts.)"
